data.name: pub_proc_text
data.value: At pickup every carpet gets a tag and a condition report with photos — before it touches water. So we always know whose carpet it is, where it is and what state it arrived in.

data.name: pub_step1_t
data.value: We measure the real area, identify the fibre and check for urine traces with a UV lamp. Everything we find is written down and photographed.

data.name: pub_step2_t
data.value: Dry dirt comes out before the carpet sees water. The step most skip — and the one that makes the biggest difference.

data.name: pub_step3_t
data.value: Fibre-matched shampoo, brushing with the pile, rinsing until the water runs clear. Wool and fringes are done cold and by hand.

data.name: pub_step4_t
data.value: Removes most of the water mechanically. Without it drying takes days and carpets come back damp.

data.name: pub_step5_t
data.value: In summer on a 200 m² outdoor drying rack, in winter and rain indoors on 100 m² with a dehumidifier.

data.name: pub_step5_n
data.value: Same turnaround in January as in May

data.name: pub_step6_t
data.value: Pile grooming, vacuuming, moisture check and wrapping. A carpet doesn't leave until the meter says it's dry.

data.name: pub_step6_n
data.value: A damp carpet in plastic wrap becomes mould

data.name: pub_faq_1a
data.value:
We clean your carpets following the instructions on their care label. We accept no liability if the material does not respond to the care instructions due to poor material quality, or if methods used during the customer's own use and care have caused damage or defects.

Carpets without a care label stating the cleaning method are cleaned solely and exclusively at the customer's own risk.

We do not guarantee removal of stains older than six months, bleach marks, burns, sun fading or moth damage.

data.name: pub_faq_2a
data.value:
You can hand in a written complaint in person at our premises, or send it by post or email. How to complain is clearly displayed on our premises and printed on the invoice.

We reply to every written complaint in writing within 15 days of receipt. We keep a record of complaints for one year.

data.name: pub_faq_3a
data.value:
The standard turnaround is {0} hours from pickup; express is {1} hours for a surcharge, subject to free drying capacity. You choose the day and the hour within our opening hours ({2}), and we call you an hour before we come.

Payment is due on delivery — cash, card or bank transfer. Business clients receive an invoice with deferred payment.

When your carpet is ready we let you know the same day, then remind you on day 7 and day 21. We are not responsible for items not collected within 30 days.

data.name: pub_faq_4
data.value: How often to clean a carpet

data.name: pub_faq_4a
data.value:
Households without pets or small children: once a year. With pets or small children: twice. Entrance runners and hallway carpets: three to four times.

For kindergartens, schools and care homes we recommend a three-month cycle, scheduled outside their working hours.
